title: Redacted secrets inventory (outputs/secrets-inventory.redacted.json)
description: ADR-0010 task V04, contract secrets-inventory. Entries are LOCATION FINGERPRINTS: where a detector fired, which detector and rule, and a closed data-class label. By design no property can carry a matched value, a fragment of one, a per-value hash, a value length, a column or the surrounding line, and every string is a const, an enum or an anchored whitespace-free pattern. Cross-record rules (tool and citation resolution, receipt binding, header agreement, line and ordinal rules) are enforced by appsec-review-process/secrets_iac_contracts.py.

attempt_id.description: The NODE attempt that published this document.

source_snapshot_sha256.description: Intake source-snapshot identity; must equal the one in tool-results.json and coverage.json.

redactor.description: Identity of the publication-boundary redactor. A copy for readers: it must equal the redactor block of outputs/redaction-receipt.json, which evidence_redaction.verify_receipt pins to the running module.

entries.description: May be empty. An empty inventory is not evidence of absence; coverage.json names the gaps.
